A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same CODA research and contain readable main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A-F. Text and rendered-page comparisons support a reliable comparison throughout.

before.justification: v1 reports original CODA experiments on object discovery, property prediction, and image generation in Section 5, with additional quantitative and qualitative analyses in Appendices C-E.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experimental results in Section 5 and Appendices C-E, including benchmark comparisons, component ablations, and generation examples.

M1.justification: Register slots, contrastive alignment, negative-slot construction, and training procedures are unchanged. Figure 2's Q-to-V correction matches the key, value, and output projection fine-tuning already specified in v1 Sections 4.2 and B.4; it does not establish a method change.

E1.justification: Both versions use MOVi-C, MOVi-E, PASCAL VOC 2012, and COCO 2017 with the same object-discovery, property-prediction, reconstruction, compositional-generation, and editing evaluations. Appendix test scenarios are also retained.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within the corresponding main-text and appendix experiments. This includes the unsupervised baselines, individual-slot comparisons in Table 7, and GLASS/GLASS† comparisons in Table 13.

E3.justification: Section 5 and Appendix B retain the same splits, preprocessing, metrics, model configurations, training budgets, and testing procedures. Table 6 and the downstream and ablation protocols are unchanged.

E4.justification: Section 5.4 and Appendices C-E retain the same component ablations, attention visualizations, individual-slot analyses, guidance-scale study, register-slot variants, contrastive-weight study, and negative-slot mixing analysis.

E5.justification: Appendix B.4 states in both versions that evaluation results are averaged over five random seeds. No run-count, uncertainty-reporting, confidence-interval, or significance-testing changes were found.

E6.justification: Quantitative results and qualitative examples are unchanged throughout. For example, CODA's COCO FG-ARI remains 47.54 in Table 2, and its compositional-generation FID remains 31.03 in Table 4. Appendix result entries and plotted trends are also identical.

T1.justification: Theorem 1, Corollary 1, their assumptions and mutual-information derivations, and the proofs in Appendix A are unchanged. No mathematical definitions or reasoning are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same scientific contributions and claims about alignment, compositionality, performance, and efficiency. The abstract's added pretrained-model availability statement concerns access information.

C2.justification: Explanations of register attention sinks and contrastive-learning tradeoffs are unchanged. Appendix F retains the same limitations concerning backbone dependence, incomplete disentanglement, fixed slot counts, reconstruction fidelity, and scaling.

D1.justification: v1 links code in the abstract and describes supplementary source code in the reproducibility statement. v2 explicitly states that code and pretrained models/checkpoints are available at the repository. Implementation details and hyperparameters in Appendix B.4 and Table 6 remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Related-work discussion, cited works, and positioning relative to earlier methods are unchanged. The bibliography reflows across pages but retains the same reference content.

P1.justification: Section 4.2's heading is shortened from 'Finetuning Cross-Attention Keys and Queries' to 'Finetuning Cross-Attention.' v2 also adds acknowledgments, updates publication headers, and revises access statements; the remaining narrative and appendix organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 2 changes two projection labels from Q to V. Page 10 spacing and Figure 5/Table 5 placement shift slightly, and references begin on page 11 instead of page 10. Other scientific displays retain their content and design.

improvement.justification: v2 modestly improves method clarity through the Figure 2 correction and Section 4.2 heading revision, and improves reproducibility documentation by explicitly identifying pretrained-checkpoint access. Scientific evidence and appendices are unchanged. The Section 4 overview still says 'keys and queries,' so the consistency correction remains incomplete.
